caption_used: 图表展示了不同超参数设置对BLEU分数的影响，包含两个子图。左图中横轴为知识蒸馏权重α，范围从0.1到0.9；右图中横轴为掩码概率p，范围从0.05到0.45。两图纵轴均为BLEU得分，范围从28.0到28.6。左图显示α=0.5时BLEU达到峰值约28.53，α=0.1时最低约27.95。右图中p=0.15时BLEU达到峰值约28.53。值得注意的是，参数p对BLEU分数的影响幅度明显大于α，p在0.25处出现显著下降至约28.1后又回升，表明模型对掩码概率的选择更为敏感；相较之下α的影响曲线则较为平缓对称。

The figure consists of two line charts that display the relationship between different hyperparameters and the BLEU score. Both charts share the same y-axis, labeled "BLEU," with a linear scale ranging from 28.0 to 28.5 in increments of 0.1. The left chart has an x-axis labeled "α" with values from 0.1 to 0.9 in increments of 0.2, while the right chart has an x-axis labeled "p" with values from 0.05 to 0.45 in increments of 0.1. In the left chart, the blue line representing the BLEU score starts at approximately 28.0 when α is 0.1, increases to a peak of about 28.53 at α = 0.5, and then decreases to around 28.1 at α = 0.9. In the right chart, the blue line starts at approximately 28.3 when p is 0.05, peaks at about 28.53 at p = 0.15, drops to around 28.4 at p = 0.25, increases slightly to about 28.45 at p = 0.35, and then decreases to approximately 28.4 at p = 0.45.
